'''Allia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims|Pilgrim]] who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] illegally during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Allia was one of many [[Pilgrims]] who followed [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Kolovish]] to the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the aftermath of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Slaver/Legends|enslavement]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartels]]. Assisting in the establishment of [[Kalikori village]], Allia was an advocate for [[Nalen Raloch]] and considered him a great hero of the village, defending the pilgrims from the [[Flesh Raider]]s. Allia and [[Keth (Twi'lek)|Keth]] aided Raloch in his hunt for the [[Fount of Rajivari]], but eventually realized that Raloch himself had been corrupted by the knowledge he was seeking.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Allia was originally a blue-skinned Twi'lek named Henni in early stages of the game, but her skin was changed to green and her name to Allia by the time of the game's release.<ref name="Henni">{{WebCite|url=http://guides.gamepressure.com/starwarstheoldrepublic/guide.asp?ID=13644|text=Guide|archivedate=20120602172510}}</ref> However, [[Henni]] will still appear if the player makes the dark side decision to kill Allia.
